raw_segments.text: The books of Ecclesiastes and the Canticles have nothing that was not Solomon's, except
it be the titles or inscriptions.
For the words of the preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem, and the song of
songs which is Solomon's, seem to have been made for distinction's sake.
Then when the books of Scripture were gathered into one body of the law, to the end that
not the doctrine only, but the authors also might be extant.
